# grafts

grafts (**gra**ph **f**orecasts for **t**ime **s**eries) is an
interactive browser app for exploring aggregated time series, such as
hierarchical, grouped and nested series, and their forecasts.

![The grafts explorer app](reference/figures/app.png)

The grafts explorer app

## Installation

You can install the development version of grafts from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mitchelloharawild/grafts) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("mitchelloharawild/grafts")
```

## Usage

grafts explores time series stored in a
[tsibble](https://tsibble.tidyverts.org/) whose keys have been
aggregated with
[`aggregate_key()`](https://fabletools.tidyverts.org/reference/aggregate_key.html).
Any structure of keys works, whether hierarchical (`State / Region`),
grouped (`Purpose * State`) or a mix of both.

``` r

library(grafts)
library(fable)

tourism_agg <- aggregate_key(
  tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips)
)
grafts(tourism_agg)
```

[`grafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts.md)
makes an explorer, which opens in the viewer or a browser when printed
in the console. The data stays in R, which serves each series only when
it is drawn, so large collections of series open quickly. Like a Shiny
app, the console waits while the explorer is open: press Ctrl+C (or Esc
in RStudio and Positron) to stop it.

To also explore forecasts, pass a [fable](https://fable.tidyverts.org/)
of forecasts for those series to `forecasts`. Each model’s forecasts and
intervals are drawn after the data.

``` r

tourism_fc <- tourism_agg |>
  model(ets = ETS(Trips), snaive = SNAIVE(Trips)) |>
  forecast(h = "2 years")
grafts(tourism_agg, forecasts = tourism_fc)
```

## Exploring

The explorer starts from the total of all series. Its left side shows
the **series graph**, where each node is a series and its children sum
to it. Clicking a node lists the ways it can be split, such as by
`Purpose` or `State`, and choosing one adds those disaggregates to the
graph. Below it, the **dimension graph** shows the structure of keys and
highlights where the explorer is.

The right side plots the series being explored above its disaggregates,
which can be shown as small multiples, overlaid, stacked (to see what
each contributes to the total) or as seasonal plots. Clicking a time
plot focuses that series, and hovering a node highlights its series
wherever it is plotted. Right-clicking a node collapses its children,
and shift-clicking pins it so series from different parts of the graph
can be compared side by side.

## Deploying

To serve the explorer from a server, add it to a plumber2 api with
[`grafts_api()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_api.md),
which takes an explorer from
[`grafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts.md).
In a plumber2 file, such as for Posit Connect:

``` r

#* @plumber
function(api) {
  grafts_api(api, grafts(readRDS("tourism_agg.rds")))
}
```

In Docker, listen on all interfaces:

``` r

readRDS("tourism_agg.rds") |>
  grafts() |>
  grafts_serve(host = "0.0.0.0")
```

Responses are cached privately and revalidated, `api/health` answers
load balancers, and the page’s links are relative, so the app works
behind a proxy that mounts it under a path prefix.
[`grafts_serve()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_api.md)
listens on port 8000 (or `GRAFTS_PORT`/`PORT`), and has no sign-in, so
keep anything private behind an authenticating proxy.

Several explorers can share one api by giving each a `path`, such as
`grafts_api(api, grafts(tourism_agg), path = "/tourism/")`.

## Shiny

[`graftsOutput()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-shiny.md)
and
[`renderGrafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-shiny.md)
put an explorer in a Shiny app. Small data are written into the page,
and large data stay in R, which serves each series through the session
as it is drawn.

The explorer tells the app what it shows, through inputs named after its
output: `input$ts_focus` is the focused series (a one-row data frame of
its keys), and `ts_children`, `ts_pinned`, `ts_split`, `ts_view`,
`ts_set`, `ts_theme` and `ts_measure` follow the rest.
[`graftsProxy()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
steers it from the server, and
[`grafts_update()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
replaces its data without starting over: when the new data have the same
series, the graph, focus, pins and views stay as they were.

``` r

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$ts <- renderGrafts(grafts(tourism_agg))

  observeEvent(input$ts_focus, {
    print(input$ts_focus)  # e.g. State = "Victoria", Region = NA
  })
  observeEvent(input$show_nsw, {
    graftsProxy("ts") |> grafts_focus(list(State = "New South Wales"))
  })
  observeEvent(input$refresh, {
    graftsProxy("ts") |> grafts_update(grafts(latest_data()))
  })
}
```

## Embedding

Small collections of series can be explored without R, on a static web
page such as a pkgdown site, a blog or GitHub Pages. An explorer from
[`grafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts.md)
in an R Markdown or Quarto chunk, or in Shiny with
[`renderGrafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-shiny.md),
is written into the page with every series, and a page can hold several
explorers.
[`grafts_save()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_save.md)
writes one to a single HTML file.

``` r

tourism <- grafts(tourism_agg, forecasts = tourism_fc,
                  options = grafts_options(height = 600))
tourism  # in a chunk
grafts_save(tourism, "tourism.html")
```

[`grafts_options()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_options.md)
chooses the views offered, the starting view and theme, and whether
visitors’ choices persist, wherever the explorer goes. Whether series
add up to their parents is detected, hiding the Stacked view and share
scales for means.

``` r

grafts(tourism_agg, options = grafts_options(
  views = c("grid", "season"), theme = "dark", persist = FALSE
))
```

Every series is written into the page, so large collections are better
served from R, in the console or with
[`grafts_api()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_api.md).
Embedded explorers use the system’s UI font, unless the page loads
[Source Sans 3](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Source+Sans+3) as the
app does.

# Package index

## Exploration

Interactive exploration of aggregated time series and their forecasts

- [`grafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts.md)
  : Explore an aggregated tsibble through its series and dimension
  graphs
- [`grafts_options()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_options.md)
  : Options for the explorer

## Serving

The explorer on a server, sending each series when it is drawn

- [`grafts_api()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_api.md)
  [`grafts_serve()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_api.md)
  : Serve the explorer with plumber2

## Embedding

The explorer on static web pages, with no R process behind it

- [`grafts_save()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts_save.md)
  : Save the explorer as a static web page

## Shiny

The explorer in a Shiny app, reporting what it shows and steered by the
server

- [`graftsOutput()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-shiny.md)
  [`renderGrafts()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-shiny.md)
  : Shiny bindings for grafts()
- [`graftsProxy()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_focus()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_pin()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_unpin()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_view()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_theme()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_measure()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_reset()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  [`grafts_update()`](https://pkg.mitchelloharawild.com/grafts/reference/grafts-proxy.md)
  : Steer an explorer in Shiny
